solvency.reading: Solvency is strong and much stronger than a year ago. Total debt is {ratios.solvency.total_debt.value} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.value} a year earlier; long-term debt went from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.parts.debt_noncurrent.value} to {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_noncurrent.value}, and net debt is {ratios.solvency.net_debt.value}, so cash exceeds debt. Debt is {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda.value} times EBITDA of {ratios.solvency.ebitda.value}, and operating income covers interest expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.value} {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage.value} times. Liabilities are {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets.value|pct} of assets, with total liabilities down to {terms.balances_now.total_liabilities.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.total_liabilities.value}. Operating lease liabilities are small at {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability.value}. The company obtained investment-grade ratings during the year, the revolver's guarantee and collateral were released, and MD&A ties lower interest expense to the debt reduction. Unconditional purchase obligations rose to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value}, modest against cash. The exposure the filings leave unsized is tax: the auditor's critical audit matter covers management's conclusion that the separation and the exchanges "qualified as tax-free transactions".

dupont.reading: Return on equity of {ratios.profitability.dupont.product.value|pct} is net margin {ratios.profitability.dupont.net_margin.value|pct} × asset turnover {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover.value} × equity multiplier {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier.value}. Net margin carries it: turnover and leverage are moderate, while a net margin above the operating margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value|pct} is something only the non-operating, tax-free Sandisk gain could produce. No prior-year decomposition is in the input, but the direction of each factor can be read from the filed figures. Net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} against revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}, so the net-margin factor rose sharply. Revenue grew while total assets were roughly flat at {terms.balances_now.assets.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.assets.value}, so turnover rose. Equity grew from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.stockholders_equity.value} to {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity.value} as debt was retired and convertible notes were settled partly in shares, so the equity multiplier is shrinking. Leverage is a fading contributor, and without the gain the return would rest on operating profit alone.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate held down by items that are ending
anomalies.what: The effective tax rate is {tax_rate.value|pct}: tax expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.value} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.value}, held down by "the gain on the retained interest in Sandisk being tax-free due to the Separation". That driver cannot recur. A Thailand tax holiday "is scheduled to expire on August 31, 2026", its benefit was already "reduced for GMT in Thailand", and stock-compensation windfalls that lowered the provision depend on the share price at vesting. Return on invested capital of {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.value|pct} and free cash flow to the firm of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.value} are both computed at the depressed rate.

anomalies.name: Year-end receivable and inventory days lengthened
anomalies.what: On year-end balances days sales outstanding rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} and days of inventory to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}. Receivables grew by {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables.value}, which MD&A ties to shipment growth, and inventory by {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.value}, tied to a production ramp in the same words used for the prior year. Quarterly receivable days rose through the year from {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} to {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, while quarterly inventory days fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}. Both annual measures remain far below fiscal 2023's {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} and {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, so this is a mild lengthening, not a collection or stock problem.

anomalies.name: Payable days lengthened by supplier terms
anomalies.what: Payable days of {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding.value} exceed inventory days of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, which holds the cash conversion cycle at {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle.value} days. MD&A puts part of the payables increase on "more favorable payment terms with suppliers", and the 10-K's tagged supplier-finance obligation rose over the year (the calculator carries no supplier-finance field). Payables stretched by terms rather than by volume unwind if terms tighten. The balance-sheet rise in payables, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change.value}, exceeds the cash-flow statement's {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change.value} by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap.value}, which the input does not explain.

anomalies.name: Quick assets short of current liabilities
anomalies.what: The quick ratio is {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio.value}: cash of {terms.balances_now.cash.value} plus receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables.value} fall short of current liabilities of {terms.balances_now.current_liabilities.value}. Cash is down from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash.value} a year earlier, and current liabilities include all remaining debt, {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.value}. With inventory counted, the current ratio of {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio.value} covers current liabilities, so this is a thin cushion rather than a gap.

anomalies.name: Unsized tax exposure if the tax-free treatment fails
anomalies.name_ko: 비과세 판단이 뒤집힐 경우의 금액 미제시 세금 위험
anomalies.what: Management concluded that the separation, the debt-for-equity exchange and the equity-for-equity exchanges "qualified as tax-free transactions", and the auditor made that conclusion a critical audit matter. The filings do not size the tax that would arise if the treatment failed. The balance sheet otherwise carries total liabilities of {terms.balances_now.total_liabilities.value}, {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets.value|pct} of assets, and net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt.value}; an unsized tax claim is the item that could change that picture, and the reported tax rate of {tax_rate.value|pct} already rests on the gain being tax-free.

anomalies.name: Net income growth rests on a gain that cannot recur
anomalies.name_ko: 반복될 수 없는 이익에 기댄 순이익 성장
anomalies.what: Net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} for the year and {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct} for the fourth quarter, far faster than operating income at {ratios.growth.operating_income.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} and {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year.value|pct}, and it slipped {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} from the third quarter while operating income rose {ratios.growth.operating_income.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct}. The difference is the Sandisk gain, which the release's cash-flow statement shows in both the quarter and the year. With the shares disposed, fiscal 2026 net income is a base that includes a gain that cannot repeat, so net income growth measured against it carries that gap.

anomalies.name: Realignment and cancelled facility projects
anomalies.what: In a year of record margins the company ran a realignment: "In 2026, the Company canceled certain facility projects and impaired related construction in progress assets", with business realignment charges through the year, a non-cash impairment booked in the fourth quarter, and cash termination benefits in the realignment table while MD&A cites higher headcount. Management frames it as optimizing capacity for growth. The charges are small against operating income of {ebit.value} and an operating margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value|pct}; the cancelled projects are the narrative sign that capacity plans were cut back during the year.

summary_ko.profitability: 매출총이익률 {ratios.profitability.gross_margin.value|pct}와 영업이익률 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value|pct}은 공시된 과거 기록 가운데 가장 높습니다. 그러나 순이익률 {ratios.profitability.net_margin.value|pct}과 ROE {ratios.profitability.return_on_equity.value|pct}는 다시 생길 수 없는 비과세 샌디스크 지분 평가이익으로 부풀려져 있어, 본업 수익성은 영업이익을 바탕으로 한 ROIC {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.value|pct}로 보는 편이 정확합니다.
summary_ko.efficiency: 평균 잔액 기준 매출채권 회수기간은 {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding.value}일, 재고 보유기간은 {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일, 매입채무 지급기간은 {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding.value}일로 현금전환주기는 {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle.value}일입니다. 연말 기준 매출채권·재고 일수는 전년보다 조금 늘었지만 2023 회계연도보다 훨씬 짧고, 매입채무 일수는 공급업체에 유리해진 결제조건의 도움을 일부 받고 있습니다.
summary_ko.liquidity: 유동비율은 {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio.value}이지만 당좌비율은 {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio.value}로 현금과 매출채권만으로는 유동부채를 모두 갚지 못하며, 남은 차입금 {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.value} 전부가 단기 부채로 분류되어 있습니다. 현금은 자사주 매입과 부채 상환으로 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash.value}에서 {terms.balances_now.cash.value}로 줄었고, 잉여현금흐름이 플러스라서 현금 소진 기간(runway)은 계산되지 않습니다.
summary_ko.solvency: 현금이 차입금보다 많아 순차입금은 {ratios.solvency.net_debt.value}이고, 이자보상배율 {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage.value}, EBITDA 대비 차입금 {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda.value}, 자산 대비 부채 {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets.value|pct}로 지급능력은 매우 튼튼합니다. 다만 분할과 지분 교환 거래의 비과세 판단이 뒤집힐 경우의 세금 부담은 공시에 금액이 나와 있지 않습니다.
summary_ko.growth: 회계연도 마지막 분기 매출은 직전 분기 대비 {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct}, 전년 동기 대비 {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct} 늘었고 연간으로는 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} 늘었으며, 영업이익({ratios.growth.operating_income.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct})과 영업현금흐름({ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct})은 더 빨리 늘었습니다. 다만 연간 수치에는 평소보다 길었던 회계연도 효과가, 순이익 성장률 {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}에는 반복되지 않는 샌디스크 평가이익이 섞여 있습니다.
summary_ko.free_cash_flow: 단순 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value}로 공시 기록상 가장 크고, 기업 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.value}, 주주 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.value}, 주식보상비용을 뺀 품질조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}까지 빠진 항목 없이 모두 계산되었습니다. 영업현금흐름이 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value|pct}에 그친 것은 현금이 들어오지 않은 샌디스크 평가이익 때문입니다.
summary_ko.dupont: ROE {ratios.profitability.dupont.product.value|pct}는 순이익률 {ratios.profitability.dupont.net_margin.value|pct} × 총자산회전율 {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover.value} × 자기자본승수 {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier.value}로 나뉘며, ROE를 떠받치는 것은 일회성 비과세 이익으로 부풀려진 순이익률입니다. 부채 상환과 주식 발행으로 자기자본이 늘어 레버리지(자기자본승수)의 기여는 줄어드는 방향입니다.

limits: This analysis reads the company's health from its own filed numbers against its own past. It forecasts nothing, and it cannot see what is not in the filings.
